description:
Disable automerge. Extend this LAST, after default-github and python, so it overrides their automerge rules -- the shared reusable-workflow pin in the former and the test-dependencies group in the latter.

For repos that have no branch ruleset, which on a personal account means every PRIVATE repo: private-repo rulesets require GitHub Pro, so there are no required status checks for GitHub's auto-merge to wait on. A Renovate PR would merge whether or not CI passed, which is strictly worse than the GitLab behaviour it replaces (only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds is true on docs, terraform and docker-apps today).

A top-level "automerge": false does NOT achieve this -- packageRules are more specific and win over it, so the preset rules would still automerge. It has to be a catch-all packageRule applied after them.

See docs/projects/github-canonical-migration.md, 'The private-repo decision'.

packageRules.description: Catch-all: nothing automerges in this repo.
